natural_language: A model declares an index i ranging over the natural numbers. A later constraint quantifies over a fresh variable that the author also named i. Decide whether the inner i and the outer i are the same object, and say what a language should do about the collision.

expected_semantics.reason: the quantified binder i shadows the module-level index i

distractors: Assuming the inner i simply refers to the outer index. It does not: the quantifier introduces a new binder, and every reference to i inside the body resolves to it.
Treating the collision as a style warning. A warning does not prevent a silent scope change; design decision D-006 makes it an error.
